profile_text.body:
Google is a public company founded in 1998, headquartered in Mountain View, California, with last reported revenue of $402.836 billion for the year ending December 31, 2025. According to its website, Google describes Gemini as "Google's AI assistant" that helps "with writing, planning, brainstorming, and more" through generative AI.

Google's AI product portfolio spans multiple categories. Gemini serves as its general LLM chat assistant. Google AI Studio offers model prototyping capabilities. For healthcare, Google offers Med-PaLM and MedLM, medical LLMs designed for clinical reasoning and healthcare data analysis, with requirements for HIPAA BAA and diagnostic liability considerations. Within Google Workspace, the company integrates AI across Google Drive, Google Meet, and other collaboration tools for summarization, captions, and note-taking. NotebookLM provides document grounding and ingests uploaded corpora. The company also maintains TensorFlow and Keras as open source ML frameworks.

Google operates eleven MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers enabling AI integration with Google Ads campaign management, Google Search Console, Google Trends, Google Calendar, Google Forms, Google News, and Google OAuth authentication systems. The company faces 208 lawsuits with California law exposure. Google is registered in the SEC database with CIK 0001652044 and trades under ticker GOOGL.
